topography.project_purpose: Bunny is primarily a yield optimization protocol that aggregates user deposits into auto-compounding vaults, historically across BSC and Polygon, using strategies such as LP token handling and staking in external platforms like Venus and PancakeSwap. Its broader recorded contract surface also includes historical or ancillary product lines and operational contracts such as MoundTokenBSC, MoundOfferingBSC, VaultMND, VaultQBTBNB, VaultFlipToQBT, PotBunnyLover, PotCakeLover, BankBNB, CompensationTreasury, and safeSwapBNB, so not all deployments should be described as a single BUNNY-reward vault family.
topography.relationship_narrative: All vaults and pools share the BUNNY token for rewards, minted by BunnyMinterV2 and distributed via BunnyChef and BunnyPool contracts. Price calculators and zap contracts provide shared infrastructure for asset valuation and deposit routing across vaults, while proxy contracts enable upgradeability for most core logic.
